profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary: I am Software Engineer with a well rounded view of development and testing experience on different platforms. I have worked on low level drivers and bootloaders to application layer on products running proprietary code and Android. As a SDET, I led creation of an android automation test framework that enabled thousands of tests that ran continuously across hundreds of devices.

positions.title: Senior Staff Software Engineer, Android Software Development
positions.description:
• Android Framework Development - Audio HAL, Bluetooth
•  Contributed to Bluetooth SCO link and VoIP audio customization on the SDM660 platform for Public Safety and Commercial Radio Products.
- APX Next All Band Smart Radio      - PCR MOTOTRBO Ion Smart radio
•  Experience working on TinyAlsa,  Android Audio Framework, Audioservice, Audiomanager, AudioFlinger, Qualcomm ASoC

positions.title: Automation Test Engineer
positions.description:
Led a team of 5 engineers to develop an Android automation test platform that enabled creation of thousands of automated tests for ship acceptance for next generation of Android Products.
The execution framework launched tests on over 200 devices, integrating it with the Jenkins CI system, running 24 hours a day, 7 days a week. Integrated test platform with ALM and enabled RabbitMQ server with Pika client to dispatch tests on devices and report test results daily for triage.
Responsibilities included architecture and design of the auto test platform as well as triage and training of the team.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer, BSP
positions.description:
OMAP 1610/1710 BSP and board bring up and driver development for SPI, I2C, USB Host and device, UART, OneWire, KeyPad on the ARM926 core. The architecture, design and implementation of the drivers was done with Rational Rose Real-time using UML and C++

Worked on development and maintenance of a boot application for ASTRO subscriber radio that is responsible for power up and upgrading of the main radio firmware. Was responsible for integration testing of a high assurance boot ROM mask for the Motorola Bravo processor

Responsible for overall USB functionality for ASTRO products which included overseeing USB chap 9 certification tests using usbcv and support to overseas development teams.
